messages:
evelyn_support: URGENT P1 -> tenant brookline-trial failing during onboarding. Provision API returns 403 on keys. Customer usage spiking and renewal in ~4w. Ticket SUP-130999 created. Looping CS for handoff.

ops-bot: Alert: 9 provisioning failures for tenant brookline-trial in last 8h. Pattern: 403 key_validation_failed. https://redwood.inc/alerts/BRK130999

nora_cs_mgr: Thanks Evelyn. I'll lead comms and coord with AE. Need quick list of impacted endpoints, last successful request time, and whether this is a platform regression or tenant config.

evelyn_support: Repro snippet (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inc/v1/tenants/brookline-trial/embeds" -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_***' -d '{"input":"x"}'
# response: { "status":403, "error":"key_validation_failed" }
```
SE tried manual rotate; some rotated keys also returned 403.

rafe_eng: We merged a change to token issuance yesterday that may impact short-lived keys. Rolling verifier back to previous build now to confirm. If rollback fixes it, we'll follow with a hotfix.

sam_se: I can run cache invalidation for brookline-trial and coordinate a 30-min repro window. Nora, can you ask the customer for 09:30am ET tomorrow and to pause automated rotation during the window? We'll need an ephemeral token via secure upload.

tariq_ae: I'll join the call. Renewal flag: high. Please prepare a short non-technical note we can send to the customer and a brief renewal update for Sales.

nora_cs_mgr: Draft customer message: "Hi Brookline team — we're investigating intermittent provisioning failures affecting API key validation. We're scheduling a troubleshooting session for tomorrow at 09:30am ET and recommend pausing automated key rotation until we complete the test. As a temporary workaround please try a manual rotate and confirm; our engineers will run a live test during the session. We'll follow up within 24 hours with a remediation plan. For urgent issues contact ops@redwood.com." Thoughts?

evelyn_support: Add SUP-130999 link and impacted endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/embeds and POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/provision. Marked P1.

rafe_eng: Rolling back now. ETA 20m for verification. If rollback clears failures we'll push a hotfix and provide RCA.

sam_se: Secure upload link prepared; will send to customer when Nora confirms window.

nora_cs_mgr: Owners: Evelyn = support contact & ticket updates, Sam = SE for repro, Rafe = eng owner, Tariq = AE follow-up. I'll update SUP-130999 and send the customer note once rollback result is confirmed.

ops-bot: Incident record created: INCIDENT-20260322-02. Escalation level: CS-P1. Runbook: onboarding-provisioning.

nora_cs_mgr: Thanks team — keep updates in the ticket and ping here for any changes. :white_check_mark:
